value.quote: We had moss building up on the tiled roof and a couple of damp spots after heavy rain. Mark came out to Ballarat East, explained what needed doing, cleaned it back properly and replaced the cracked tiles he found along the way. It was a relief to have it sorted before winter set in.
value.author: Helen C.

value.quote: Our roof in Brown Hill was looking tired and the pointing had started to break away in a few spots. Mark handled the repointing and repainting without making a fuss, kept the site tidy, and the colour match worked well with the brickwork. Straightforward job, done properly.
value.author: Dave R.

value.quote: We wanted the concrete tile roof restored on our place in Soldiers Hill and were fairly particular about the finish. Mark talked through the prep, pressure cleaning, sealing and coats before starting, then checked a few ridge cap issues while he was up there. The roof looks clean and even now, not patchy.
value.author: Priya S.
